infoPages.content: Cartify is Pakistan's premier destination for curated fashion, footwear, bags, and everyday essentials with guaranteed Cash on Delivery across 200+ cities.

infoPages.content: We ship all orders across Pakistan via Trax Logistics, TCS, and Leopards Express. Standard delivery takes 2-4 working days.

infoPages.title: 7-Day Easy Returns & Exchange
infoPages.content: If you receive a damaged or incorrect item, or if the size doesn't fit, you can request an exchange or return within 7 days of delivery.

infoPages.title: Privacy Policy
infoPages.content: Your personal details and contact numbers are strictly confidential and only used for order dispatch and courier tracking updates.

infoPages.title: Terms & Conditions
infoPages.content: By placing an order on Cartify Pakistan, you agree to inspect packages upon arrival and provide accurate shipping address details for Cash on Delivery dispatch.
